settings.breed_blurb: Glamorous, silky and effortlessly stylish — Shih Tzus were born for the spotlight and look exquisite in every outfit.
settings.tip_lehenga: Lightweight silk or chiffon lehengas complement the Shih Tzu's flowing coat beautifully. Keep back length under 32 cm for comfort.
settings.tip_sherwani: Embroidered mini sherwanis in gold or ivory look absolutely regal on a Shih Tzu. Pair with a matching pagri for wedding photos.
settings.tip_tshirt: Soft jersey tees in XS keep a Shih Tzu cosy on cooler days without matting their long coat.
settings.tip_colours: White, gold, blush pink and baby blue look stunning against the Shih Tzu's multi-toned silky coat.
